items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Major Holly was a great tuba player.

ctx.x: Why was the — you know you said in your recent CD here that the tuba kind of went out of favor, late twenties?

Late twenties and the beginnings of the swing era, beginnings when the bands started to get really larger, the big band kind of things. Still some big bands held on to a tuba player that doubled on bass like many bass players that came through that period — Slam Stewart, Major Holly, a lot of them played tuba. Major Holly was a great tuba player.
You even have a picture of Pops Foster.
